Class Player

java.lang.Object
Player
All Implemented Interfaces:
Hit, Stay
Direct Known Subclasses:
Dealer
class Player extends Object implements Hit, Stay
The Player class creates the player objects allowing it to take certain actions with the player's hand As its constructors it takes a name, initial betting amount(betAmount) and a Deal object Within the class is a private inner class Bank which stores the betting amount the player has and handles wins/losses/pushes keeping it to just the Player object The class implements both Hit and Stay, and creates both for their abstract methods excluding the Hit's getCard method which is a default method of the interface
